RE: Response to Objections (PUC Item 4726) and Motion for Remote Appearance / Waiver —
PUC Docket No. 59475 / SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349

To the Honorable Administrative Law Judge and Parties of Record:

I, John B. Bradley III, appearing pro se in the above-referenced matter, submit this letter to
formally address the Applicants’ Objections (PUC Item 4726) and to request necessary
accommodation for my testimony due to my active-duty military service.

1. Withdrawal of Exhibits and Correction of Testimony

In response to the Applicants’ Objections, | hereby concede the objections regarding the
formal admissibility of the following exhibits filed under PUC Interchange Item 3921. |
formally withdraw the following Exhibits from consideration:

e Withdrawn Exhibits: 7, 8, 13, 14, 15, 16, 24, 25, 26, 28, 29, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 38a,
41, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 48, 49, 54, 76, 77, 78, and 80.

[have revised my pre-filed statements in my Direct Testimony to ensure compliance with
the Texas Rules of Evidence (TRE). Specifically, pursuant to TRE 602 (Personal Knowledge)
and TRE 701 (Lay Witness Opinion), my testimony is based exclusively on my firsthand
experience as a rancher and my familiarity with my own property. Additionally, | have
removed the originally labeled Section X. Property Value Impacts from this direct
testimony.

I. CURE OF OBJECTIONS AND REQUEST FOR ADMISSION

Respondent respectfully submits that, with the removal or revision of the objections
identified by Applicants, the testimony contained in PUC Item 3921 now complies with
applicable Texas Administrative Code requirements and the Texas Rules of Evidence
governing lay testimony, personal knowledge, and admissibility. Respondent further notes
that, aside from the objections specifically identified by Applicants and subsequently

 addressed, no additional objections were raised to PUC Item 3921. Accordingly,
Respondent respectfully requests that the revised testimony and supporting exhibits be
pre-approved and admitted into the evidentiary record before the hearing on merit on June
8" 2026. The revised testimony is uploaded on the PUC Interchange as Item
